name: rds_instance
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk standalone AWS RDS instance.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this RDS instance.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the RDS instance.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this instance to a cloud provider account.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (under an environment) this instance belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group.

attributes.name: engine
attributes.description: Database engine (e.g. postgres, mysql, mariadb, oracle-se2, sqlserver-ex).

attributes.name: engine_version
attributes.description: Engine version. Changing this in place triggers an engine upgrade.

attributes.name: db_instance_class
attributes.description: Instance class (e.g. db.t3.medium, db.r6g.large).

attributes.name: allocated_storage
attributes.description: Allocated storage in GiB. Required when creating a new instance (not restoring from a snapshot).

attributes.name: storage_type
attributes.description: Storage type (e.g. gp2, gp3, io1).

attributes.name: multi_az
attributes.description: Deploy the instance across multiple availability zones.

attributes.name: availability_zone
attributes.description: Availability zone for a single-AZ instance.

attributes.name: db_name
attributes.description: Name of the initial database created in the instance.

attributes.name: master_username
attributes.description: Master (admin) username. Required when creating a new instance (not restoring from a snapshot).

attributes.name: master_user_password
attributes.description: Master user password.

attributes.name: visibility
attributes.description: Network visibility of the instance. Accepted values are defined by the backend RdsVisibility enum (e.g. private vs. public); confirm the exact value against your tenant.

attributes.name: db_subnet_group_name
attributes.description: DB subnet group the instance is placed in.

attributes.name: vpc_security_group_ids
attributes.description: VPC security group IDs attached to the instance.

attributes.name: storage_encrypted
attributes.description: Storage encryption mode. Accepted values are defined by the backend RdsStorageEncryptionMode enum; confirm the exact value against your tenant.

attributes.name: kms_key_id
attributes.description: KMS key that encrypts storage, as a key id or ARN, honoured only when storage_encrypted is ResourceGroupKmsKey. The key must already be registered on the resource group (duploai_resource_group_kms_key) or on a plan attached to its environment (duploai_plan_kms_key) — the platform resolves it against those registries and rejects an unregistered key. Leave it unset to use the resource group's own default key. Independent of performance_insights_kms_key_id: storage and Performance Insights are keyed separately. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: backup_retention_period
attributes.description: Number of days automated backups are retained.

attributes.name: auto_minor_version_upgrade
attributes.description: Automatically apply minor engine version upgrades.

attributes.name: enable_iam_database_authentication
attributes.description: Enable IAM database authentication.

attributes.name: enable_performance_insights
attributes.description: Enable Performance Insights.

attributes.name: performance_insights_encryption_mode
attributes.description: How Performance Insights data is encrypted: AwsDefaultRdsKey (the default) uses the AWS-managed RDS key, ResourceGroupKmsKey uses a customer-managed key — either the resource group's default key or the one named by performance_insights_kms_key_id. Only meaningful when enable_performance_insights is true. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: performance_insights_kms_key_id
attributes.description: KMS key that encrypts Performance Insights data, honoured only when performance_insights_encryption_mode is ResourceGroupKmsKey. The key must already be registered on the resource group (duploai_resource_group_kms_key) or on a plan attached to its environment (duploai_plan_kms_key); an unregistered key is rejected. Leave it unset to use the resource group's own default key. Independent of storage_kms_key_id — these are two unrelated keys. Supply the key ARN rather than the bare key id: the platform resolves this field in place and stores the ARN, so a bare id would read back as the ARN and show as a change on the next plan. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: database_insights_mode
attributes.description: Database Insights mode (e.g. standard, advanced).

attributes.name: snapshot_identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of a snapshot to restore the instance from.

attributes.name: deletion_protection
attributes.description: Enable deletion protection on the instance.

attributes.name: ca_certificate_identifier
attributes.description: CA certificate identifier for the instance.

attributes.name: parameters
attributes.description: DB parameter group overrides.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Parameter name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Parameter value.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.

attributes.name: rds_instance_id
attributes.description: ID of this RDS instance, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: endpoint
attributes.description: Connection endpoint (DNS address) of the RDS instance.

attributes.name: port
attributes.description: Port the RDS instance listens on.

attributes.name: stack_id
attributes.description: ID of the underlying provisioning stack.
